name: CITAGLB
recent: Citaglobal 近期宣布拟以 RM50 million 出售 Manjaran 的 20% 股权，并通过发行 BProperty 新股支付；同时与 Masdar、TIZA Global 启动浮式太阳能项目，并签署红树林碳信用合作。公司也完成多项凭单与优先股转换，股本有所增加。
notable: 拟以 RM50 million 出售 Manjaran 20% 股权予 Berjaya Property，并以每股 RM0.28 发行 178,571,429 股 BProperty 新股支付。
与 Masdar 及 TIZA Global 为浮式太阳能项目举行动工仪式。
与 Kitaran Tabah 签署合作，探讨彭亨及楠榜的红树林碳保护碳信用项目。
risks: 凭单 C 及不可赎回可转换优先股持续转换为新股，股本逐步扩大。
董事在闭市期前表示有意进行证券交易。
Genetec 退出与 Citaglobal 的合资公司。
earnings: 2026 年 6 月 30 日止期间，营收为 RM214.234 million，净利为 RM7.307 million，净利率 3.4%。营收环比增长 219.9%，同比增长 107.4%；净利环比增长 30.7%，同比增长 138.0%。

recent_en: Citaglobal recently announced a proposed RM50 million divestment of its 20% stake in Manjaran, to be satisfied via new BProperty shares; it also started construction of floating solar projects with Masdar and TIZA Global, and signed a mangrove carbon credit partnership. The company also completed several warrant and preference share conversions, increasing its share base.
notable_en: Proposed disposal of 20% stake in Manjaran to Berjaya Property for RM50 million, satisfied via 178,571,429 new BProperty shares at RM0.28 each.
Marked start of construction for floating solar projects with Masdar and TIZA Global.
Signed partnership with Kitaran Tabah to explore mangrove conservation carbon credit projects in Pahang and Lampung.
risks_en: Ongoing conversion of Warrants C and irredeemable convertible preference shares into new ordinary shares, gradually enlarging the share base.
Director indicated intention to deal in securities during the closed period.
Genetec exited its joint venture with Citaglobal.
earnings_en: For the period ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM214.234 million and net income was RM7.307 million, with a net margin of 3.4%. Revenue grew 219.9% QoQ and 107.4% YoY; net income rose 30.7% QoQ and 138.0% YoY.
